requirement: Teach It Back - AI驱动学习应用，基于苏格拉底教学法和费曼学习法
clarifying_questions: What specific subjects or topics will the Teach It Back feature focus on?
Should the app support voice recording for explaining concepts, or only text input?
How should the AI provide feedback - through questions, corrections, or suggestions?
What level of interactivity is needed during the 'teaching back' session?
Should there be progress tracking and analytics for learning effectiveness?
What platforms should be supported - Android only or cross-platform?
How will user privacy be handled with respect to their learning content?

alternatives.name: Simple Voice-to-Text Approach
alternatives.description: User speaks their explanation, app converts to text and analyzes with basic keyword matching

alternatives.name: AI-Powered Socratic Method
alternatives.description: Advanced AI asks follow-up questions to probe understanding and uncover knowledge gaps

alternatives.name: Hybrid Interactive Tutor
alternatives.description: Combines voice/text input with structured exercises and AI-guided questioning

recommended_design.name: AI-Powered Socratic Method
recommended_design.rationale: Best aligns with the Teach It Back philosophy of revealing understanding gaps through questioning. Provides the most value for learning effectiveness.

overall.description: UI Layer -> ViewModel -> Repository -> (Room Database / AI API / File Processor / Voice Processor)

topics_fragment.description: Topic management and learning entry point with progress cards

error_handling.network_errors: Use cached data, fallback to offline mode
error_handling.ai_service_errors: Show friendly prompts, implement retry mechanism
error_handling.database_errors: Data recovery mechanism, data integrity check

performance_optimization.local_first: Prioritize local database for instant response
performance_optimization.async_operations: Background AI requests with LiveData updates

core_components: Room Database with Topic and Message entities
Repository layer for data access abstraction
ViewModel with LiveData for state management
AI service integration (OpenAI API or custom)
File processing service for PDF/text extraction
technical_architecture: MVVM architecture with ViewModel and LiveData
AI service integration (OpenAI API or similar)
development_phases: Phase 1: Data layer - Database entities and DAOs
Phase 2: Repository layer - Data access and caching
Phase 3: ViewModel layer - State management and business logic
Phase 4: UI layer - Activities, Fragments, and layouts
Phase 6: File processing - PDF and text extraction
